scenario.region_label: Fictional operator network placed in real Western Province towns (not real tower locations or coverage)

reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Dehiwala tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
WhatsApp from field staff (05:00): Beruwala site eka dead machan, cabinet lights off, need equipment team
Call centre: 11 customers around Payagala say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Beruwala tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CLEARED | BER22 Beruwala RBS | all sectors in service

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.
policy.on_crew_loss: Pause affected unfinished work and request operator review; preserve completed repairs.

finding.finding: Beruwala has conflicting equipment status evidence: an unverified field message reports a fault, while an authoritative snapshot reports all sectors in service.

No resolved faults are established: operational equipment, grid power, links, and roads default to true, and S01 equipment has conflicting reports rather than a resolved fault. No repair or generator action should be held on the supplied evidence. The S01 equipment conflict blocks deciding whether equipment repair is needed.

questions.question: Can you verify whether S01 equipment is currently operational? The supplied reports conflict, so equipment repair need is unresolved.

finding.finding: No outage is established by the supplied state or reports. The approved weights remain unchanged: V02 (S02) is critical at weight 5; all other listed services are standard at weight 1. The reports do not provide credible evidence warranting a priority proposal.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling

finding.explanation: Prediction from verified evidence; unknown assets are conservatively unavailable. Unmet needs may remain.

findings: The plan has no actions, so there are no target, timing, travel, or arithmetic claims to challenge.

REP-001 reports Beruwala equipment lights off, but it is unverified; REP-002 is an authoritative snapshot reporting BER22 in service and supports equipment_ok=true. The plan conservatively schedules no work.

The Payagala complaint reports poor service but does not establish a specific operational attribute. The Dehiwala notice and Beruwala social-media rumor likewise do not establish a current operational fact, so they do not make the no-action plan inconsistent with the evidence.
